text: Youth hostels (Jugendherbergen) take guests of all ages. Rooms may be shared, and many ask you to bring your own sheets or rent them. Campsites (Campingplätze) are common and well equipped, and camping outside a campsite is generally not allowed in Germany.
If something is wrong in a hotel, tell reception politely and at once, ideally in person. Staff will usually help, and will often offer another room or a small reduction.
